runtime_identity_gate.timing: before source engine startup, identity access, pairing secrets, or authenticated transport
runtime_identity_gate.repair_policy: replace the package with a complete checksum-verified copy; do not rewrite managed files during verification

computer_awareness: advisory labels and local defaults only; never a launch, ownership, handoff, lease, wait, write-fence, or read-only gate

security_boundary.firewall_changes: explicit FirewallAdd or FirewallRemove mode only after runtime identity verification
